title: Quack: The DuckDB Client-Server Protocol
summary: DuckDB introduced 'Quack', a new client-server protocol that enables remote execution of DuckDB queries over a network, transforming DuckDB from a purely in-process OLAP database into a client-server database system capable of handling distributed analytical workloads.
problem_solved: Enables remote access to DuckDB databases, allowing client applications to execute analytical queries against DuckDB servers over network connections.
why_valuable: Expands DuckDB's use cases from embedded-only scenarios to full client-server architecture, enabling distributed OLAP workloads while maintaining DuckDB's renowned analytical performance.
